ItemBase.lua.rule: Weapon and PoorWeapon presets use the receiver GameItem name and physical dimensions.

GunsmithInspectorProcessor4SOL.lua.rule: SOL selection uses GetPresetID4SOL, bound to RecFunction.DefaultPreset.

GunsmithInspectorProcessor.lua.rule: IsAllowPreset4Build requires IsBaseWeapon, a nonzero default preset and mode compatibility.

ShopServer.lua.rule: Count the receiver and recursively each components.prop_data at its dynamic guide price times its actual quantity. Model-only parts have zero price. Loaded ammunition is an optional separate term.

local_sale_policy.pricing: Use existing local initial guide prices of the actual default parts; do not use placeholder abstract preset prices.
local_sale_policy.deduplication: One source default preset per actual receiver; equal names or metadata do not collapse distinct firearms.
